This competition will use Dual Rounds for 3x3 and FTO so **everyone** will have the opportunity to set **at least 2 averages.**

The winner of **FTO** will be announced as the winner of the competition.

items.name: Kubing in Kapiti 2027
items.information:
Kubing in Kapiti 2027 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition.

This competition is open to all competitors regardless of age, experience, or skill. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary.

Please make sure to read all the information in the tabs before registering. All competitors should be familiar with the information in these tabs.

[FAQ](https://speedcubing.org.nz/faq)
